author: sam diago
html:
Interesting introduction to bx-jwt and its enterprise-focused approach to JSON Web Token management in BoxLang. I like how the article highlights secure authentication, scalability, and developer-friendly integration for modern enterprise applications. JWT-based authentication has become essential for APIs, cloud-native apps, and distributed systems, so having a dedicated enterprise-grade solution inside the BoxLang ecosystem is a valuable addition for developers and organizations alike. Great technical overview and practical direction for secure application development.

https://atechreview.com/
